description.value: Vina Vietnamese Restaurant is a sit-down Vietnamese restaurant on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. It sits along a busy cycling corridor on the north shore, making it a potential meal stop for cyclists exploring the area. The restaurant maintains a smoke-free environment.
